def: to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain, decide

occurrences.text: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
